args.line: Experience the suspended silence of an orbital station where gravity is merely a suggestion.
args.subtitle: A docking sequence in deep orbital space.
why: The gravity anchor points and bulkhead screen act as a decompression transition, forcing you to slow your pace as you enter the station.
The monolithic gravity engine serves as the visual gravitational center of the store, dictating a slow, meditative path around the space.
The eyewear containment pods are placed at the periphery to ensure that viewing the hero and browsing the product are two distinct, contemplative acts.
The mission control terminal marks the physical conclusion of your dock, grounding your experience before you exit the hangar.
args.quote: A docked moment suspended in the celestial expanse.
args.synopsis: You enter through the gravity bulkhead, stepping into the weightless silence of the hangar. Before you stands the monolithic gravity engine, a monumental anchor point around which your movement naturally drifts. You observe the eyewear containment pods as if they were delicate artifacts floating in the void. As you complete your journey, you finalize your mission at the command terminal.
args.title: Orbital Docking Hangar

stops.sub: The air here feels thin, heavy with the weight of interstellar stillness.
stops.cap: I step through the narrow gravity bulkhead into the vast, silent hangar.
I hover at the edge of the void, drawn to the monolithic gravity engine.
stops.sub: It sits in total silence, an ancient artifact grounding this floating space.
Each pair is suspended as if caught in a permanent moment of zero gravity.
stops.cap: Turning away, I drift towards the containment pods to inspect the eyewear.

# Orbital Docking Hangar

You enter through the gravity bulkhead, stepping into the weightless silence of the hangar. Before you stands the monolithic gravity engine, a monumental anchor point around which your movement naturally drifts. You observe the eyewear containment pods as if they were delicate artifacts floating in the void. As you complete your journey, you finalize your mission at the command terminal.
